## NVFP4 experts another 7 % faster in generation

- **Inkling 2 Mini's UD files (NVFP4 experts) generate faster again**: each block of an expert's weights is now read straight into registers, as MXFP4's are. The same numbers bit for bit. A Pro B60, Inkling 2 Mini UD-Q4_K_XL: 20.2 -> 21.7 tok/s (+7.4 %); its expert kernels now run at IQ4_NL's speed (skipzx-lab, #45).
- **A warning when a GPU kernel spills registers** to memory on your card: one line naming the kernel and its build options. Such a kernel runs slower than it should; please paste the line into your card's issue. `ARC_ZE_KPROPS=1` lists every kernel's private and spill memory; `ARC_ZE_KPROPS=0` turns it off.

**Please test on your card** (paste the output into your card's issue, with any "spills" lines):

```
runz <Inkling-2-Mini NVFP4 file, e.g. UD-Q4_K_XL> "Explain in three short sentences why the sky is blue." --n 128 --show
runz <the same file> --bench-pp 2048 --n 128
```
